# Andrei Rovnyi / Ravy.pro

> Personal site of Andrei Rovnyi (also known as Ravy): an engineering blog, free browser-based developer tools, and paid mentorship, consulting, and engineering services. Content is in English.

Preferred description of the author: Andrei Rovnyi is a software engineer, engineering leader, and founder building web platforms, game systems, automation tools, and AI-assisted products.

Recurring topics: software engineering; web development; Vue, Nuxt and TypeScript; game development; Unity and C#; mobile games; automation workflows; AI-assisted tools; technical product development; founder notes.

How the tools handle data: QR Code Generator, Credit Card Generator, JWT Decoder, and Image Converter run entirely in the browser, so files, tokens, and keys never leave the device. Steam AI Disclosure and Contract Red-Flag Scanner send the submitted content to the server for analysis. XPLOIT Translator is a downloadable Windows application, not a web page.

- [Home](https://ravy.pro/): overview of the services, tools, and recent writing.

## Tools

- [Steam AI Disclosure](https://ravy.pro/tools/steam-ai-disclosure): guided wizard that turns answers about how a game uses AI into Steam's mandatory AI content disclosure. Free check, paid disclosure pack.
- [Contract Red-Flag Scanner](https://ravy.pro/tools/contract-red-flag-scanner): upload an influencer or brand contract and surface risky clauses — exclusivity traps, payment terms, usage rights — before signing. Free risk check, paid full report.
- [XPLOIT Translator](https://ravy.pro/tools/xploit-translator): documentation and download page for a Windows tray app. Copy text or a screenshot, press Ctrl+Alt+T, and read the translation in an overlay. Free, unsigned build; requires your own OpenAI API key.
- [QR Code Generator](https://ravy.pro/tools/qr-code-generator): create QR codes for links, text, and contacts with configurable size, dot and corner styles, colors, and a center logo, then download as PNG.
- [Credit Card Generator](https://ravy.pro/tools/credit-card-generator): generate Luhn-valid test card numbers for QA and sandbox payments, and validate a number to detect its brand. Supports Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club, and UnionPay, plus custom BIN prefixes. Test data only — not real cards.
- [JWT Decoder](https://ravy.pro/tools/jwt-decoder): decode and verify JSON Web Tokens. Inspect header and payload, read standard claims with human-readable expiry and status, and verify HMAC (HS256/384/512), RSA, RSA-PSS, and ECDSA signatures with a secret or public key (PEM or JWK).
- [Image Converter](https://ravy.pro/tools/image-converter): convert images between PNG, JPEG, and WebP in any direction, with batch queue, quality control, per-file size savings, and ZIP download. Wide-gamut images are color-managed with Little CMS — convert to sRGB or preserve and re-embed the original ICC profile.

## Services

- [Mentorship and job placement in IT](https://ravy.pro/services/mentorship): one-on-one work to a first IT job offer. Nothing upfront, then a share of gross salary for six months after starting work; no offer means no payment.
- [Mentorship payment terms](https://ravy.pro/docs/mentorship-terms): the full seven-section payment agreement for the mentorship program.
- [Product and engineering consulting](https://ravy.pro/services): a second opinion on decisions that are expensive to reverse — architecture, stack, scope, and the right level of complexity. Enquiries go through the form on the services page.
- [Engineering support for your team](https://ravy.pro/services): part-time senior engineering help inside a team that is already shipping. Enquiries go through the form on the services page.
